description: Cubic yards, bags, weight and coverage of topsoil for a lawn, a top-dressing pass, a garden bed or a raised box, with the published depth of each job and the soil already on the ground subtracted. Estimate only; confirm with your plans, supplier and local code.

bagCuFt.description: Cubic feet in a bag. Unit: cu ft.

base.description: Base. Unit: ft (imperial) or m (metric). A number in that unit, or a string that carries its own unit such as "20 ft 6 in". Shown on the site only when "shape=triangle" is set.

density.description: Supplier density. Unit: lb / cu yd. Optional.

depth.description: Depth. Unit: in (imperial) or cm (metric). A number in that unit, or a string that carries its own unit such as "20 ft 6 in". Default in metric: 10.16cm.

diameter.description: Diameter. Unit: ft (imperial) or m (metric). A number in that unit, or a string that carries its own unit such as "20 ft 6 in". Shown on the site only when "shape=circle" is set.

existing.description: Topsoil already on the ground. Unit: in (imperial) or cm (metric). A number in that unit, or a string that carries its own unit such as "20 ft 6 in". Shown on the site only when "job=new-lawn" is set.

height.description: Height (perpendicular to the base). Unit: ft (imperial) or m (metric). A number in that unit, or a string that carries its own unit such as "20 ft 6 in". Shown on the site only when "shape=triangle" is set.

length.description: Length. Unit: ft (imperial) or m (metric). A number in that unit, or a string that carries its own unit such as "20 ft 6 in". Default in metric: 6. Shown on the site only when "shape=rectangle" is set.

priceBag.description: Price per bag. Unit: $ / bag (imperial) or $ / bag (metric). Optional.

priceYd.description: Price per cubic yard. Unit: $ / cu yd (imperial) or $ / m³ (metric). Optional.

system.description: Unit system the inputs are typed in and the defaults are taken from.

truck.description: Truck capacity. Unit: cu yd (imperial) or m³ (metric). Optional.

width.description: Width. Unit: ft (imperial) or m (metric). A number in that unit, or a string that carries its own unit such as "20 ft 6 in". Default in metric: 3. Shown on the site only when "shape=rectangle" is set.

name: calc_topsoil
title: Topsoil Calculator
